torrent_sub: Search across enabled sources — results sorted by seeders
torrent_no_sources: No sources enabled. Enable at least one in Settings.
jackett_checking: Checking whether the service is running…
jackett_detected: {flavor} detected on this PC — URL and API key filled in automatically.
jackett_not_detected: No indexer service found — install one to continue.
jackett_install_body: Torznab needs a local Jackett (or Prowlarr) service running on this machine. FLUX talks to it over localhost — the service is what actually searches the torrent sites. It runs locally but needs internet to search.
jackett_install_step1: On the official Jackett GitHub page, download the build for your platform and install it.
jackett_install_step2: It opens its dashboard at http://localhost:9117 — add the trackers you want.
jackett_install_step3: Come back here and click "Load indexers".
nzb_sub: Forward .nzb files to your SABnzbd or NZBGet server.
nzb_target_unconfigured: NZB forwarding not configured — see Settings → Integrations
subs_help: Follow a search — FLUX checks it periodically (Settings → Scheduler) and auto-queues new, not-yet-grabbed matches. For titles without a ready-made RSS feed (see RSS's own auto-download for those).
